snippet.title: GTA 6 - Where to find Military Fighter Jet Location
snippet.description:
How to get a military fighter jet in GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI). You can find it at the Mile Zero Air Station in the south of the map. Drive through the gate and quickly run to the airfield before the soldiers catch you.

It's easiest to drive past them with a motorcycle. You can also use the stunt jump over the dirt hill in the south-east corner of the base.

Note that stealing a fighter jet gives you a wanted level. The military will come to chase you down. The jet has a military tracker so they will know where you are.

snippet.title: How to Get a Fighter Jet in GTA 6 in Under 60 Seconds
snippet.description:
Here is how to get a fighter jet in GTA 6 in under sixty seconds. Head down to Mile Zero Air Station at the very bottom of the map. Use the main gate in the middle, not the side entrances. Right before the gate, stay to the left, because a truck blocks the right side. Then turn right onto the main road inside the base. Now carefully drive over the flower beds on your left to get onto the road behind them. Take it slow here, because you cannot knock them down. Then floor it, go straight and take the first right. Keep going, and twenty yards later the jet is right there. Slam the brakes, run over and jump in. Then pick up speed fast, fire up the engines and take off. Watch out, because fighter jets will chase you and attack. But you can hit the eject button at any time and launch yourself out of the plane. You have to try it.
